moduleMap.description: `null` while the Architect has not written the first map.

dependsOn.description: Names of other modules. A cycle here gets the map REJECTED on write.

version.description: History is immutable: each new map is one more version, and the current one is the one with the highest `version`.

actionId.description: Id of the `open_adr_pr` `proposed_action` that opened the ADR.

pullRequestUrl.description: `null` while the PR has not actually been opened.

pendencies.description: Story↔map cross-validation. An empty list is the healthy state.

reason.description: `no_module`: the story doesn't point at any module. `missing_module`: it points at one that doesn't exist in the current map.

missing.description: The cited modules that don't exist. Empty when `no_module`.

status.description: `sem_diagrama` is the initial state: the Architect has not generated one yet.

diagrama.description: The current diagram, or `null` while there is none.

description.example: Whoever operates the product through the web.

contextDiagram.description: Mermaid `C4Context` syntax — the system and the external actors.

containerDiagram.description: Mermaid `C4Container` syntax — the current module_map's modules and the dependencies between them.

version.description: Version of the current artifact; 0 when there is no diagram. Revising means generating again — history is never rewritten.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
